title: Third reel: fireworks and blank pistol on early jobs
summary: Hirsch recalls David Wade with fireworks and a blank pistol at their first job.

blocks.x: Well, okay, we got the third reel, Godfrey Hirschhorn. Who shot off fireworks on the job? You know, you were a kid?
He had his fireworks and his blank pistol. The first job that we played, I told you we had to put long pants on him.
